T: Swap houses. Keep the cheese board.
D: Two heartbroken women swap homes for Christmas, one in Surrey and one in Los Angeles.
P: Serve the snacks when Amanda opens the door of the snowy Surrey cottage.
S: Aged cheddar, brie and blue cheese with oatcakes, quince paste, apple slices and walnuts on a wooden board by the fire.

Toast topped with a cheddar, mustard and ale sauce, grilled until bubbling and brown. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour and 80ml ale, then add 200g grated cheddar, 1 tsp mustard and a dash of Worcestershire until thick.
Amanda's huge house in Los Angeles
Baby carrots, radishes, cucumber and snow peas around a green goddess dip of avocado, herbs, lemon and Greek yoghurt.
M: Iris throwing a dinner for Arthur and his old friends
Whole chickens rubbed with lemon butter and thyme, roasted at 200C for 75 minutes, with roast potatoes, glazed carrots and gravy from the pan.
dinner with Graham and his two daughters
Spaghetti with a slow tomato and butter sauce simmered 45 minutes with a halved onion, finished with basil and lots of parmesan, simple enough for the girls to love.
W: Date sponge baked at 180C for 35 minutes, poked and soaked with a toffee sauce of brown sugar, butter and cream, served warm with vanilla ice cream.
K: Christmas by the fire in the cottage
Red wine warmed slowly with orange, cinnamon, cloves, star anise and honey, never boiled, ladled into mugs.

s.how: Bring 150g each of aged cheddar, brie and blue cheese to room temperature. Arrange on a wooden board with oatcakes, a slab of quince paste, sliced apple and a handful of walnuts. Set it by the fire with a glass of something warm.
Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour and 80ml ale, then add 200g grated cheddar, 1 tsp mustard and a dash of Worcestershire until thick. Spread on 6 slices of toast and grill until bubbling.

m.note: dinner with Graham and his two daughters
m.how: Simmer 2 cans crushed tomatoes with 80g butter and a peeled halved onion for 45 minutes, stirring now and then. Remove the onion and season. Toss with 500g cooked spaghetti, then finish with torn basil and plenty of grated parmesan.

w.how: Soak 200g chopped dates in 250ml boiling water with a pinch of bicarb. Cream 60g butter with 150g brown sugar, add 2 eggs, the dates and 175g self-raising flour. Bake at 180C for 35 minutes, poke holes and pour over hot toffee sauce. Serve with ice cream.

d.note: Christmas by the fire in the cottage
d.how: Pour a bottle of red wine into a pot with a sliced orange, 2 cinnamon sticks, 4 whole cloves, a star anise and 2 tbsp honey. Warm gently for 20 minutes, never letting it boil. Ladle into mugs by the fire with snow falling outside.
